en: Chromolithographic multi-view postcard with the caption 'Gruss aus Bad Driburg', showing a panoramic view of the spa town, a vignette of 'Logirhäuser' (lodging houses), and the 'Brunnenhalle' with strolling visitors. The reverse reads 'Postkarte' and bears a green 5 Pfennig REICHSPOST stamp cancelled in Driburg (Westfalen); addressed to Bielefeld and stamped with a blue archive mark 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
